name: Dropdown
description: Opens a menu of actions or navigational items.

attributes.name: secondary-text
attributes.description: Adds text before the main label.

attributes.name: icon-only
attributes.description: Uses the icon slot as the complete trigger.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controls whether the menu is open.

attributes.name: keep-open
attributes.description: Keeps the menu open after selection.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Defines menu items programmatically when declarative noora-dropdown-item children are not used.

slots.name: search
slots.description: Search content above the item list.

events.name: noora-open-change
events.description: Emitted when the dropdown opens or closes.

events.name: noora-select
events.type: CustomEvent<{ item: Record<string, unknown>; value: unknown }>
events.description: Emitted when an enabled item is selected.

notes: Selections emit a `noora-select` event with the selected item.

examples.title: Default
examples.markup:
<noora-dropdown label="Dropdown">
  <noora-dropdown-item value="1">Item 1</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="2" right-icon="chevron_right">Item 2</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="3" secondary-text="Foo">Item 3</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="4" icon="category">Item 4</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="5">Item 5</noora-dropdown-item>
</noora-dropdown>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disable the complete menu when its actions are unavailable.

examples.title: Large items
examples.description: Use larger rows for prominent action menus.
examples.markup:
<noora-dropdown label="Dropdown with large items">
  <noora-dropdown-item value="1" size="large" icon="category">Item 1</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="2" size="large" icon="category">Item 2</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="3" size="large" icon="category" secondary-text="Foo">Item 3</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="4" size="large" icon="category">Item 4</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="5" size="large" icon="category">Item 5</noora-dropdown-item>
</noora-dropdown>

examples.title: Trigger icon
examples.description: Add an icon to the dropdown trigger.

examples.title: Secondary text
examples.description: Add concise context beside an item label.

examples.title: Icons and secondary text
examples.description: Combine visual cues with supporting text.
examples.markup:
<noora-dropdown label="Date" secondary-text="Order by">
  <noora-icon slot="icon" name="category"></noora-icon>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="1" secondary-text="Foo">Item 1</noora-dropdown-item>
</noora-dropdown>

examples.title: Hint
examples.description: Explain the purpose of the menu below its trigger.
examples.markup:
<noora-dropdown label="Dropdown" hint="This is a hint">
  <noora-dropdown-item value="1">Item 1</noora-dropdown-item>
</noora-dropdown>

examples.title: Checkbox items
examples.description: Communicate selected items with checkbox indicators.
examples.markup:

  <noora-dropdown-item value="monday" checkable checked>Monday</noora-dropdown-item>
  <noora-dropdown-item value="tuesday" checkable checked>Tuesday</noora-dropdown-item>
